description: x402 endpoint check. Any public https URL in, a payment-posture scorecard out, probed live on the call: the 402 challenge decoded from the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header or the body, the advertised scheme, network, amount, asset, pay-to, and resource graded by fixed rules, with latency and the raw probe outcome. Unreachable targets return their fetch outcome as the result. Price: $0.002 per call, paid in USDC on Base mainnet over x402; an unpaid call answers HTTP 402 with the exact machine-readable payment terms.

url.description: The public https URL of the x402 endpoint to check, e.g. https://example.com/api. http, IP literals, userinfo, and private hostnames are rejected.

name: x402-endpoint-check
